title: Quebec City Shore Excursion: Private Walking Tour
includes: Live commentary in English or French. Just make sure to specify the language you prefer when booking.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Wear suitable clothing according to weather
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: While in port in Quebec City, explore the city's charming sites by foot on this 2.5-hour private shore excursion. Walk to Place d’Hôtel de Ville, City Hall, Place Royale, the famous Chateau Frontenac hotel and more. You can customize the tour to your interests, and your knowledgable local guide will provide interesting and informative commentary on the place you see.
